title: Word Frequency
description:
Count how many times each word appears in `"to be or not to be that is the question to be"`. Print each unique word and its count, sorted alphabetically.

**Expected output:**
```
be: 3
is: 1
not: 1
or: 1
question: 1
that: 1
the: 1
to: 3
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
text = "to be or not to be that is the question to be"
expectedOutput:
be: 3
is: 1
not: 1
or: 1
question: 1
that: 1
the: 1
to: 3
hint: Split text into words, use a dict to count, then sort the dict keys before printing.
